commands: set -o pipefail; curl -fsSL https://gh-proxy.com/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Funnyrz/docklane/main/scripts/install-online.sh | sudo bash -s -- --channel stable
checks: Public mirror installer matches the committed main bootstrap
Explicit stable stops clearly when no stable release is available
No-argument command selects beta and repeat installation succeeds from public assets
Both invocations preserve binary inode/hash, master key, config, application/Docker PID and receipt
Service remains active and enabled; health endpoint returns 200
Existing administrator login and saved settings are retained
All eight success stages appear in order; failed stable request never reports later stages or completion
Actual release downloads identify files and completion using plain text in redirected stderr
Bilingual testing-only disclaimer appears before the verified application installation stage
environment: Isolated native arm64 Ubuntu 24.04 systemd VM
limitations: Repeat installation on existing beta; no fresh install or new cross-platform matrix

local_checks.skip_reason: One lifecycle test requires Linux; local runner is macOS
progress_cases: All eight stages appear in order and completion follows successful deployment
Failure stops before later stages and completion
Download messages do not contaminate captured URL metadata
PTY selects curl progress bar; redirected stderr selects plain text
